_comment: Single source of truth for the dev environment. Install-Workstation.ps1 reads this. Bump a version here, re-run the bootstrap, and commit the change.

winget.purpose: javac/java for helpers, R8/D8, apktool, jadx, Gradle
mirror and control the phone over ADB

cmdlineTools._note: Per host OS, SHA-1 from Google's repository2-3.xml (the publisher's own checksum).

androidSdk._note: Names use the Android CLI form (slash, not sdkmanager's semicolon). android-37.0 = Android 17, the image's OS. The SDK's platform-tools are for Android Studio; device work uses the pinned copy in work/platform-tools (inputs.platformTools).

archives.name: jadx-1.5.6.zip
archives.purpose: jadx command-line decompiler (the winget package is GUI-only)

deviceTools._note: Optional tools for the prepared device (docs/develop/instrumentation.md, docs/device/dev-setup.md). Downloaded into work/device-tools/, git-ignored. Bumping these is routine, unlike the inputs section. buildOnly entries are image-build inputs (the Fossify APKs built into vedotom_arm64): only the build machine downloads them; Install-Workstation.ps1 -InstallPc skips them.

frida._note: pip pins for work/.venv-frida: frida==version (must match the server above), frida-tools==toolsVersion

gsi._note: Google's AOSP arm64 GSI for Android 17, the stable release of the same drop as the source tag below; booted through DSU by deploy/Install-Gsi.ps1 (docs/device/gsi.md) and run on this device on 2026-11-19 (step 0 of the tag move, docs/develop/image-backlog.md section 7). Not fetched by the bootstrap: the download is ~1 GB and behind Google's terms, which the script asks you to accept. Until 2026-11-19 this was the Android 16 GSI BP4A.251205.006 (sha256 2171cf0e...).
gsi.name: aosp_arm64-exp-CP2A.260605.012-15430684-8e545e1e.zip

aosp._note: Source for building your own GSI in WSL (image/build/*.sh, docs/develop/aosp-build.md). The tag is the AOSP release of the same Android 17 drop as the pinned GSI binary above (android-17.0.0_r1 is CP2A.260605.016 per source.android.com/docs/setup/reference/build-numbers; the GSI binary is CP2A.260605.012), so what you build matches what was validated. Builds 1 to 9 came from android-16.0.0_r4 (BP4A.251205.006); Android 16 was dropped on 2026-11-19. The lunch target is verified against `lunch` after the first sync. treeDir is where the scripts put the tree in WSL (AOSP_DIR overrides it).

inputs._note: The device procedure's exact tested inputs (docs/device/walkthrough.md, validation.md). Downloaded into work/ ($Work), which is git-ignored. Change these only when deliberately re-validating the procedure.

platformTools._note: The tested platform-tools. Google lists only the newest release in its index, so other hosts are pinned when first validated there.

motorolaDriver.name: Motorola_Mobile_Drivers_64bit.msi
motorolaDriver._note: No stable direct URL; download manually from the support page. The bootstrap verifies it if present.
